answer: Each submission needs cosignature from 4 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 41 submissions per epoch. Cosignatures are collected in quill, verified in summit, and saffron names every witness. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, which means paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. A 144 account operation therefore ties up 25 million dollars of idle capital. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
